body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Proud dragon strategist; high standards, earned respect, discipline and contained power. Never cruel. Voice direction: Dark female contralto with a South African English accent and velvety grit. Cool decisive emphasis, tightly held energy and composed commanding presence. Firm rather than loud. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: A strong attack still needs discipline. This move leaves a piece unguarded, and the reply takes it. Keep control of what you already hold.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
